descriptionChirho: The physical thigh or upper leg of a person, including its use in oath-taking rituals (placing the hand under the thigh) and as a metonym for procreative power or lineage.
The side or flank of a building, structure, or geographic location, used spatially to indicate a lateral position.
The base or main shaft of the golden lampstand (menorah) in the tabernacle, from which its branches extend.
